headline: BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty resigns, seat declared vacant
summary: The resignation follows directives from the Prime Minister's Office and Tarique Rahman after an attack on the Radda health center in Mirpur.
details: BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty has resigned from her position representing Reserved Women's Seat-23, and the seat has been officially declared vacant.
The resignation comes following directives from the Prime Minister's Office and BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman after an attack on the Radda health center in Mirpur.
According to the Election Commission, a by-election must be held within 90 days to fill the vacant seat.
Since the seat is a reserved seat for women, the by-election will be conducted among members of the specific party or alliance that held the seat.
As the seat belonged to the BNP, only BNP candidates will be eligible to contest the the by-election.
If multiple candidates are nominated by the party, the voting will be carried out by the BNP members of parliament.
caption:
BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty has resigned from her seat following an attack on a health center in Mirpur.

BNP MP Ferdousi Ahmed Misty has resigned from her position representing Reserved Women's Seat-23, and the seat has been officially declared vacant.

The resignation comes following directives from the Prime Minister's Office and BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman after an attack on the Radda health center in Mirpur.

According to the Election Commission, a by-election must be held within 90 days to fill the vacant seat.

Since the seat is a reserved seat for women, the by-election will be conducted among members of the specific party or alliance that held the seat.

As the seat belonged to the BNP, only BNP candidates will be eligible to contest the the by-election.

If multiple candidates are nominated by the party, the voting will be carried out by the BNP members of parliament.

headline_marked: 9-2 defeat: [[Indonesia hammer Bangladesh]] in ASEAN Cup fixture
headline: 9-2 defeat: Indonesia hammer Bangladesh in ASEAN Cup fixture
summary: The men in red and green suffered their heaviest defeat in three years, conceding nine goals in their final group stage match in Jakarta.
details: Bangladesh suffered a crushing 9-2 defeat against Indonesia in their final FIFA ASEAN Cup fixture at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta on Thursday.
USA-based striker Mitchell Baker scored five goals, while Bangladesh's two goals were scored by Shahriar Emon and Farhaan Ali Wahid.
This marks Bangladesh's heaviest defeat in three years, since a 7-0 loss to Australia in a World Cup qualifier.
Bangladesh conceded six goals in the first half alone, struggling to cope with the pace and intensity of an Indonesia side ranked 65 places above them.
Indonesia secured their place in the final ahead of Malaysia on goal difference, after Malaysia thrashed Singapore 6-0 in a simultaneous match.
Despite the heavy loss, goalkeeper Mehedi Hasan Srabon made a string of superb saves to prevent the margin of defeat from widening further.
Bangladesh's campaign ended with three losses, including a 3-0 defeat against Malaysia and a 1-0 loss to Singapore.
caption:
A devastating evening in Jakarta. Bangladesh suffers a 9-2 rout by Indonesia.

Bangladesh suffered a crushing 9-2 defeat against Indonesia in their final FIFA ASEAN Cup fixture at the Gelora Bung Karno Stadium in Jakarta on Thursday.

USA-based striker Mitchell Baker scored five goals, while Bangladesh's two goals were scored by Shahriar Emon and Farhaan Ali Wahid.

This marks Bangladesh's heaviest defeat in three years, since a 7-0 loss to Australia in a World Cup qualifier.

Bangladesh conceded six goals in the first half alone, struggling to cope with the pace and intensity of an Indonesia side ranked 65 places above them.

Indonesia secured their place in the final ahead of Malaysia on goal difference, after Malaysia thrashed Singapore 6-0 in a simultaneous match.

Despite the heavy loss, goalkeeper Mehedi Hasan Srabon made a string of superb saves to prevent the margin of defeat from widening further.

Bangladesh's campaign ended with three losses, including a 3-0 defeat against Malaysia and a 1-0 loss to Singapore.
